records.topic: Sensor and switch wire colours at the ECM
records.statement: Wire colours at the ECM on the 2010-2012 CRF250R and CRF450R: 5 V sensor supply red/yellow; sensor ground green/red; throttle position signal yellow/green; intake pressure signal light green/yellow; intake air temperature signal gray/blue; coolant temperature signal pink; No.1 crank sensor blue/yellow; No.2 crank sensor white/yellow; fuel injector black/blue with pink/yellow supply; ignition coil yellow/blue; engine stop switch black/white; warning light white/blue; diagnostic line orange/black. The throttle and intake pressure sensors share the 5 V supply and the sensor ground; the two temperature sensors return on the sensor ground. Honda's colour letters: Bl black, Y yellow, Bu blue, G green, R red, W white, Br brown, O orange, Lb light blue, Lg light green, P pink, Gr gray.
